checks.detail: Slim base, apt cache cleaned, every package justified (git/tmux/strace for Harbor, ffmpeg/libgl1/libglib2.0-0 for moviepy+opencv).
Only solve.sh (with toolchain validation) and scene.py (identical to source_scene.py, expected overlap).
Every section serves a purpose: clean-room wipe removes reference video before re-render, source grep blocks file I/O cheats, strace prevents background process survival.
reasons: useful: source-level grep catching cv2.VideoCapture/open/exec/etc (task-specific: prevents reading reference.mp4)
useful: clean-room wipe + pristine tarball restore excluding reference.mp4 (ensures agent code runs without access to reference)
useful: pkill -9 -u agent before re-render (kills lingering agent processes)
useful: strace-wrapped execution (blocks background process survival past render phase)
useful: symlink check on output.mp4 (prevents trivial reference link)
